protocol.ap_denominator: min(5, number of unique full validation-relevant programmes)

protocol.ground_truth: all unique validation interaction IDs; never filtered to candidates or train items
protocol.required_output: exactly five distinct positive candidate IDs per user
protocol.selection: highest submission_all MAP@5; variant-order tie break

watch_seconds.score_definition: sum of train total_watch_seconds; no capping
